correctedCritiques.con-contradictions-as-defeasible-costs: Strongest feature: The reply contests the categorical contrast through paraconsistent logic, showing contradiction as survivable and defeasible, thereby supporting comparative evaluation of logical and explanatory costs rather than automatic theoretical defeat. Principal limitation: Survivability cannot establish that contradictions and ordinary explanatory awkwardness inhabit a homogeneous continuum, since contradictions may preserve distinctive inferential consequences even where explosion is blocked. Live burden: The position must articulate principled dimensions for comparing heterogeneous costs and demonstrate their application to the deliberative anomaly, rather than resting on abstract logical possibility. Locked score: The very strong band reflects recognizable conceptual support, explicit qualification, close engagement with the opposing distinction, and proportionate force, while compressed applicability and the unresolved severity comparison constrain its broader contribution.
